# Ablation Documentation

Ablation is an AI-assisted reverse engineering (AIARE) framework.

## Where would you like to start?

- **[Getting Started](Getting-Started)** - Install Ablation and complete your first analysis.
- **[Choose a Workflow](Workflows)** - Follow a task-focused guide for your artifact or research goal.
- **[Explore Capabilities](Capabilities)** - Browse analysis domains and find the right tools.
- **[Module Reference](Module-Reference)** - Look up a module by capability or letter.
- **[Known Limitations](Known-Limitations)** - Check unsupported cases, false negatives, and review requirements.
- **[What's New](Releases)** - Read the changelog, release notes, and support matrix.

This Wiki is generated from [`docs/`](https://github.com/Ablation-Tool/ablation/tree/main/docs). Edit documentation in the repository, not in the Wiki. Updates publish automatically after they reach `main`.
